caption: The drawing features several abstract, organic shapes outlined in red, distributed across a primarily diagonal, gray-shaded rectangular area centered on a white background. The forms vary, including multiple circular and oval elements connected with curved lines or stems, and many of the shapes have radiating lines or branch-like projections extending outward. There are grouping and repetition of these forms: two round shapes with radiating lines appear at the bottom left and near the bottom middle, while several interconnected circular and elongated shapes are grouped in the top center and right parts of the drawing. In the lower left quadrant, a shape incorporating two joined, elongated ovals and several protruding lines is present. Near the center, spirals, rounds, and tubular forms merge and connect, forming complex configurations. The overall color palette is limited, with the red lines and forms set against the muted, shaded gray background and the white of the surrounding margin.
title: Petroglyph
